payload.headline: Half the checks failed: voucher VAT type, invoice VAT type, and payment amount/type issues
what_went_wrong: Voucher posting used vatType id 0 which may not be the correct VAT type for purregebyr; the correct exempt/zero VAT type ID may differ, causing Check 4 to fail.
Reminder fee order used vatType id 6 (likely a specific VAT rate) instead of the correct VAT-exempt type for purregebyr (65 NOK fee), causing Check 5 to fail.
Partial payment registration on invoice 2147660438 likely used wrong parameters (amount, paymentType, or date not matching expected 5000 NOK), causing Check 6 to fail.
The agent created the overdue invoice from scratch rather than finding an existing one; the sandbox may have had a pre-existing overdue invoice that should have been used.
what_worked: Voucher was successfully created with correct accounts (1500 debit, 3400 credit) and amount 65 NOK.
Reminder fee invoice was created and sent successfully via email.
what_to_try_next: Search for existing overdue invoices first with GET /invoice?invoiceDueDateFrom=...&invoiceDueDateTo=today before creating new ones; the task says 'finn den forfalne fakturaen' implying one exists.
For purregebyr voucher and invoice, use vatType id 3 (NO_VAT or equivalent) and verify the correct vatType for zero-rated fees in the sandbox ledger.
For PUT /invoice/:payment, explicitly pass paymentAmount=5000, paymentTypeId, and paymentDate as query parameters to ensure the partial payment is registered correctly.
unnecessary_calls: GET /ledger/account called 3 times separately; could be combined into one call with accountNumberFrom/To filter to get all needed accounts at once.
POST /order for overdue invoice was unnecessary if an existing overdue invoice was already present in the sandbox.
